content: Inside the dry shelter of the wattle shed, rain pattered softly against the cedar shingles. The gloom smelled of dry hay and dust. In the corner sat two empty flour sacks and a cracked stone mortar, sheltered from the cold wind howling off the coast.
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
